examples.english: Butoh is an avant-garde dance art form that originated in Japan.

notes:
Refers to dance as a formal or artistic activity. Most commonly encountered in the compound {舞踏|ぶとう}{会|かい} (ball, dance party), and in ⟦{暗黒|あんこく}→暗黒：12997_ankoku⟧{舞踏|ぶとう} (butoh), a form of Japanese avant-garde dance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {舞踏|ぶとう}{会|かい}: ball, dance party
- {舞踏|ぶとう}⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧: dance music
- ⟦{暗黒|あんこく}→暗黒：12997_ankoku⟧{舞踏|ぶとう}: butoh (avant-garde dance)
- {舞踏|ぶとう}{家|か}: dancer (professional)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{舞踊|ぶよう}→舞踊：05410_buyou⟧: dance — broader term that includes both Japanese traditional dance and Western dance
- ⟦ダンス→ダンス：03856_dansu⟧: dance — loanword for casual or modern dancing
- ⟦{踊|おど}り→踊り：01347_odori⟧: dance — everyday word for dancing, especially folk or festival dances
- {舞|まい}: dance — refers specifically to the slow, elegant dance style of Noh and traditional court dance
